units.zh: 高行周，字尚質，幽州人也。
units.en: Gao Xingzhou, whose courtesy name was Shangzhi, came from Youzhou.
units.literal: Gao Xingzhou, courtesy name Shangzhi, was a native of Youzhou.

units.zh: 生於媯州懷戎軍之雕窠裏。
units.en: He was born at Diaoke, in the Huairong garrison of Guizhou.
units.literal: He was born at Diaoke village in Huairong Army of Guizhou.

units.zh: 曾祖順厲，世戍懷戎。
units.en: His great-grandfather was Shunli; the family had served in the Huairong garrison for generations.
units.literal: His great-grandfather was Shunli; the family had garrisoned Huairong for generations.

units.zh: 父思繼，昆仲三人，俱雄豪有武幹，聲馳朔方。
units.en: His father Siji was one of three brothers, all fierce warriors with outstanding military ability whose fame rang across the northern frontier.
units.literal: His father Siji was one of three brothers, all bold and talented in military affairs, whose fame spread throughout the northern frontier.

units.zh: 唐武皇之平幽州也，表劉仁恭為帥，仍留兵以戍之。
units.en: When Emperor Wu of Tang subdued Youzhou, he had Liu Rengong appointed military commissioner and left a garrison force behind.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu of Tang pacified Youzhou, he recommended Liu Rengong as commander and left troops to garrison the region.

units.zh: 以思繼兄為先鋒都將、媯州刺史，思繼為中軍都將、順州刺史，思繼弟為後軍都將，昆仲分掌燕兵。
units.en: The eldest brother was named vanguard commander and military governor of Guizhou; Siji took the central army and the governorship of Shunzhou, while the youngest brother was appointed rear-army commander. The three brothers between them controlled the Yan forces.
units.literal: Siji's elder brother was made vanguard commander and governor of Guizhou; Siji was made central-army commander and governor of Shunzhou; Siji's younger brother was made rear-army commander—the brothers between them divided command of the Yan armies.

units.zh: 部下士伍，皆山北之豪也，仁恭深憚之。
units.en: The troops beneath them were all fierce champions from north of the passes, and Liu Rengong held them in deep dread.
units.literal: The soldiers under their command were all powerful men from north of the passes, and Rengong deeply feared them.

units.zh: 武皇將歸，私謂仁恭曰：「高先鋒兄弟，勢傾州府，為燕患者，必此族也，宜善籌之。」
units.en: When the emperor was preparing to withdraw, he took Rengong aside and said, "The Gao brothers of the vanguard overshadow the whole prefecture. If anyone is going to bring trouble to Yan, it will be that family. You must deal with them wisely."
units.literal: As the emperor was about to return home, he said privately to Rengong, "The Gao brothers of the vanguard dominate the prefectures and commanderies; the men who will plague Yan are surely this clan—you should plan carefully."

units.zh: 久之，太原戍軍恣橫，思繼兄弟制之以法，所殺者多。
units.en: In time the Taiyuan garrison grew arrogant and lawless. The Siji brothers enforced discipline upon them, and many were executed.
units.literal: After a long while the Taiyuan garrison troops grew unruly; the Siji brothers restrained them by law, and many were put to death.

units.zh: 太祖怒，詬讓仁恭，乃訴以高氏兄弟，遂並遇害。
units.en: The founding emperor flew into a rage and upbraided Rengong, who then laid the blame on the Gao brothers. They were all put to death.
units.literal: The founding emperor was enraged and rebuked Rengong; he then complained about the Gao brothers, and they were all killed.

units.zh: 仁恭因以先鋒子行珪為牙將，諸子並列帳下，厚撫之以慰其心。
units.en: Rengong therefore appointed the vanguard's son Xinggui as a guard officer, brought all the sons into his own retinue, and treated them generously to win their hearts.
units.literal: Rengong therefore made the vanguard's son Xinggui a guard officer, placed all the sons under his command, and treated them generously to reassure them.

units.zh: 時行周十餘歲，亦補職，在仁恭左右。
units.en: Xingzhou was then barely in his teens; he too was given a post and served at Rengong's side.
units.literal: At that time Xingzhou was just over ten years old; he too was given a post and attended on Rengong.

units.zh: 行珪別有傳，在《唐書》。
units.en: Xinggui has his own biography in the 《Book of Tang》.
units.literal: Xinggui has a separate biography in the 《Book of Tang》.

units.zh: 及莊宗收燕，以行周隸明宗帳下，常與唐末帝分率牙兵。
units.en: When Emperor Zhuangzong reconquered Yan, Xingzhou was assigned to Emperor Mingzong's retinue and often shared command of the guard troops with the Last Emperor of Tang.
units.literal: When Emperor Zhuangzong recovered Yan, Xingzhou was placed under Emperor Mingzong's command and often shared leadership of the guard troops with the Last Emperor of Tang.

units.zh: 明宗征燕，率其下擁從。
units.en: When Mingzong marched against Yan, he led his men in close attendance.
units.literal: When Mingzong campaigned against Yan, he led his men in escort.

units.zh: 鄉人趙德鈞謂明宗曰：「行周心甚謹厚，必享貴位。」
units.en: A fellow townsman, Zhao Dejun, told Mingzong, "Xingzhou is deeply sincere and steady in character. He is bound to rise to great eminence."
units.literal: His fellow townsman Zhao Dejun said to Mingzong, "Xingzhou's heart is very sincere and steady; he is sure to attain high rank."

units.zh: 梁將劉鄩之據莘也，與太原軍對壘，旦夕轉鬥。
units.en: When the Liang general Liu Xun held Shen, he faced the Taiyuan army in a standoff and skirmished from morning to night.
units.literal: When the Liang general Liu Xun held Shen, he faced the Taiyuan army across the lines and fought day and night.

units.zh: 嘗一日，兩軍成列，元行欽為敵軍追躡，劍中其面，血戰未解。
units.en: On one occasion, as the two armies drew up in battle order, Yuan Xingqin was chased by the enemy. A sword cut his face, and the bloody struggle went on without respite.
units.literal: Once, as the two armies formed their lines, Yuan Xingqin was pursued by the enemy; a sword struck his face, and the bloody fight would not end.

units.zh: 行周以麾下精騎突陣解之，行欽獲免。
units.en: Xingzhou led his finest horsemen in a charge through the enemy formation and broke the encirclement, and Xingqin was saved.
units.literal: Xingzhou led his elite cavalry in a charge through the enemy lines and rescued him; Xingqin escaped.

units.zh: 莊宗方寵行欽，召行周撫諭賞勞，而欲置之帳下，又念於明宗帳下已奪行欽，更取行周，恐傷其意，密令人以利祿誘之。
units.en: Zhuangzong was then showering favor on Xingqin. He summoned Xingzhou to praise and reward him and wished to bring him into his own retinue. Yet he reflected that he had already lured Xingqin away from Mingzong; to take Xingzhou as well might wound Mingzong's feelings, so he secretly sent an envoy to tempt him with wealth and office.
units.literal: Zhuangzong was then favoring Xingqin; he summoned Xingzhou to comfort, praise, and reward him and wished to place him in his own retinue. Yet he reflected that he had already taken Xingqin from Mingzong's command, and to take Xingzhou as well might wound Mingzong's feelings, so he secretly sent someone to entice him with profit and rank.

units.zh: 行周辭曰：「總管用人，亦為國家，事總管猶事王也。
units.en: Xingzhou refused, saying, "The commander-in-chief appoints men for the state's sake as well. To serve the commander-in-chief is to serve the throne.
units.literal: Xingzhou declined, saying, "The commander-in-chief employs men for the sake of the state as well; to serve the commander-in-chief is like serving the king.

units.zh: 余家昆仲，脫難再生，承總管之厚恩，忍背之乎！」
units.en: My family and brothers were given a new life after escaping ruin. We owe the commander-in-chief a profound debt of gratitude—how could I turn my back on him!"
units.literal: My family and brothers were reborn after escaping disaster and owe the commander-in-chief deep kindness—how could I bear to betray him!"

units.zh: 及兩軍屯於河上，覘知梁軍自汴入楊村寨，明宗晨至斗門，設伏將邀之，眾寡不敵，反為所乘。
units.en: While the two armies were encamped along the Yellow River, scouts reported that the Liang forces had entered Yangcun stockade from Bian. Mingzong reached Dou Gate at dawn and laid an ambush to cut them off, but his numbers were too few and he was instead caught at a disadvantage.
units.literal: When the two armies were encamped on the Yellow River, scouts learned that the Liang army had entered Yangcun stockade from Bian. Mingzong reached Dou Gate at dawn and set an ambush to intercept them, but being outnumbered he was instead taken at a disadvantage.

units.zh: 時矛槊叢萃，勢甚危蹙。
units.en: Spears and halberds closed in from every side, and the situation grew desperately tight.
units.literal: Spears and halberds pressed in on every side; the situation was extremely perilous.

units.zh: 行周聞之，出騎橫擊梁軍，遂得解去。
units.en: When Xingzhou heard what had happened, he led his cavalry out in a flanking charge against the Liang army, and Mingzong was able to break free.
units.literal: When Xingzhou heard of it, he led his cavalry out in a flanking strike against the Liang army, and they were able to break free.

units.zh: 明宗之襲鄆州也，行周為前鋒。
units.en: When Mingzong stormed Yunzhou, Xingzhou led the vanguard.
units.literal: When Mingzong attacked Yunzhou, Xingzhou served as vanguard.

units.zh: 會夜分澍雨，人無進誌，行周曰：「此天贊也，彼必無備。」
units.en: At midnight a downpour began, and the men lost all heart for advancing. Xingzhou said, "Heaven is on our side. The enemy will surely be caught off guard."
units.literal: At midnight a heavy rain fell, and the men had no will to advance. Xingzhou said, "Heaven is aiding us; the enemy will surely be unprepared."

units.zh: 是夜，涉河入東城，比曙平之。
units.en: That night they forded the river and entered the eastern city. By dawn the place was pacified.
units.literal: That night they crossed the river and entered the eastern city; by dawn it was pacified.

units.zh: 莊宗平河南，累加檢校太保，領端州刺史。
units.en: After Zhuangzong pacified Henan, Xingzhou was repeatedly promoted, eventually to honorary Grand Guardian, and was made military governor of Duanzhou.
units.literal: When Zhuangzong pacified Henan, Xingzhou was repeatedly promoted to honorary Grand Guardian and made governor of Duanzhou.

units.zh: 同光末，出守絳州。
units.en: Near the end of the Tongguang era he was sent out to hold Jiangzhou.
units.literal: At the end of the Tongguang era he went out to guard Jiangzhou.

units.zh: 明宗即位，特深委遇。
units.en: When Mingzong came to the throne, he placed exceptional trust in Xingzhou.
units.literal: When Mingzong took the throne, he entrusted Xingzhou with exceptional favor.

units.zh: 天成中，從王晏球圍定州，敗王都，擒禿諾，皆有功。
units.en: During the Tiancheng era he followed Wang Yanqiu in the siege of Dingzhou, helped defeat Wang Du, and took part in capturing Tuo Nuo, distinguishing himself in each action.
units.literal: During the Tiancheng era he followed Wang Yanqiu in besieging Dingzhou, defeated Wang Du, and captured Tuo Nuo—all with merit.

units.zh: 賊平，遷潁州團練使。
units.en: After the rebels were crushed, he was made regimental commissioner of Yingzhou.
units.literal: When the rebels were pacified, he was transferred to be regimental commissioner of Yingzhou.

units.zh: 長興初，以北邊鄰戎王，用為振武節度使。
units.en: Early in the Changxing era, because the northern frontier bordered the Rong king's territory, he was appointed military commissioner of Zhenwu.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Changxing era, because the northern border adjoined the Rong king's territory, he was appointed military commissioner of Zhenwu.

units.zh: 明年，以河西用軍，移鎮延安。
units.en: The following year, with military operations under way in Hexi, he was transferred to Yan'an.
units.literal: The next year, because troops were being used in Hexi, he was transferred to garrison Yan'an.

units.zh: 清泰初，改潞州節度使。
units.en: Early in the Qingtai era he was made military commissioner of Luzhou.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Qingtai era he was made military commissioner of Luzhou.

units.zh: 晉祖建義於太原，唐末帝命張敬達征之，行周與符彥卿為左右排陣使。
units.en: When the founding emperor of Jin raised his banner at Taiyuan, the Last Emperor of Tang sent Zhang Jingda against him. Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing served as the left and right battle-array commanders.
units.literal: When the founding emperor of Jin raised the righteous cause at Taiyuan, the Last Emperor of Tang ordered Zhang Jingda to campaign against him; Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing served as left and right battle-array commanders.

units.zh: 契丹主入援太原也，行周、彥卿引騎拒之，尋為契丹所敗，遂與敬達保晉安寨，累月救軍不至。
units.en: When the Khitan ruler marched in to relieve Taiyuan, Xingzhou and Yanqing led their cavalry out to block him but were soon defeated. They then held Jin'an stockade with Jingda, and for months no relief force arrived.
units.literal: When the Khitan ruler entered to aid Taiyuan, Xingzhou and Yanqing led cavalry to resist but were soon defeated by the Khitan; they then held Jin'an stockade with Jingda, and for months no relief army came.

units.zh: 楊光遠欲圖敬達，行周知之，引壯士護之。
units.en: Yang Guangyuan plotted against Jingda. Xingzhou learned of it and led picked warriors to guard him.
units.literal: Yang Guangyuan plotted against Jingda; Xingzhou learned of it and led stalwart men to protect him.

units.zh: 敬達性戇，不知其營護，謂人曰：「行周每踵余後，其意何也？」
units.en: Jingda was a blunt man and did not realize he was being guarded. He said to others, "Xingzhou is always at my heels—what is he after?"
units.literal: Jingda was blunt by nature and did not know of this protection; he said to others, "Xingzhou follows at my heels every day—what does he mean by it?"

units.zh: 繇是不復敢然，敬達遂為光遠所害。
units.en: After that Xingzhou no longer dared to keep guarding him, and Jingda was then killed by Guangyuan.
units.literal: From this Xingzhou no longer dared to keep guarding him, and Jingda was then killed by Guangyuan.

units.zh: 晉祖入洛，令行周還藩，加同平章事。
units.en: When the founding emperor of Jin entered Luoyang, he ordered Xingzhou back to his post and made him co-equal to the Secretariat-Chancellery.
units.literal: When the founding emperor of Jin entered Luoyang, he ordered Xingzhou to return to his commandery and added the title of co-equal to the Secretariat-Chancellery.

units.zh: 晉祖都汴，以行周為西京留守，未幾，移鄴都。
units.en: When the founding emperor of Jin established his capital at Bian, he made Xingzhou regent of the western capital. Before long he was transferred to the Ye capital.
units.literal: When the founding emperor of Jin made his capital at Bian, he appointed Xingzhou western capital regent; before long he was transferred to the Ye capital.

units.zh: 晉祖幸鄴，會安從進叛，命行周為襄州行營都部署。
units.en: When the founding emperor of Jin visited Ye, An Congjin rebelled, and Xingzhou was appointed overall commander of the Xiangzhou field headquarters.
units.literal: When the founding emperor of Jin visited Ye, An Congjin rebelled, and Xingzhou was appointed overall commander of the Xiangzhou field headquarters.

units.zh: 明年秋，平定漢南。
units.en: The following autumn the south of Han was pacified.
units.literal: The following autumn the south of Han was pacified.

units.zh: 晉少帝嗣位，加兼侍中，移鎮睢陽。
units.en: When the young emperor of Jin succeeded, Xingzhou was additionally made Palace Attendant and transferred to Suiyang.
units.literal: When the young emperor of Jin succeeded, Xingzhou was additionally made Palace Attendant and transferred to garrison Suiyang.

units.zh: 開運初，從幸澶淵，拒敵於河上。
units.en: Early in the Kaiyun era he accompanied the emperor to Chanyuan and held the enemy on the Yellow River.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Kaiyun era he accompanied the emperor to Chanyuan and resisted the enemy on the river.

units.zh: 車駕還京，代景延廣為侍衛親軍都指揮使，移鄆州節度使。
units.en: When the emperor returned to the capital, he replaced Jing Yanguang as commander of the palace guard and was made military commissioner of Yunzhou.
units.literal: When the imperial carriage returned to the capital, he replaced Jing Yanguang as commander of the palace guard and was made military commissioner of Yunzhou.

units.zh: 時李彥韜為侍衛都虞候，可否在己。
units.en: At that time Li Yantao was deputy commander of the palace guard, and every decision rested in his hands alone.
units.literal: At that time Li Yantao was deputy commander of the palace guard, and approval or denial rested with him alone.

units.zh: 行周雖典禁兵，心遊事外，退朝歸第，門宇翛然，賓友過從，但引滿而已。
units.en: Although Xingzhou commanded the palace guard, his mind was elsewhere. After court he would return home to a house kept quiet and spare, and when guests and friends called he did nothing but raise his cup.
units.literal: Although Xingzhou commanded the forbidden troops, his mind wandered outside affairs; after court he returned home, his gates serene, and when guests and friends called he merely filled the cup.

units.zh: 尋改歸德軍節度使，以李守貞代掌兵柄，許行周歸藩。
units.en: Soon he was made military commissioner of the Guide Army. Li Shouzhen took over command of the troops, and Xingzhou was allowed to return to his post.
units.literal: Soon he was made military commissioner of the Guide Army; Li Shouzhen replaced him in command of the troops, and Xingzhou was permitted to return to his commandery.

units.zh: 晉軍降於中渡也，少帝命行周與符彥卿同守澶州。
units.en: When the Jin army surrendered at Zhongdu, the young emperor ordered Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing to hold Chanyuan together.
units.literal: When the Jin army surrendered at Zhongdu, the young emperor ordered Xingzhou and Fu Yanqing jointly to hold Chanyuan.

units.zh: 契丹入汴，召赴京師，會草寇攻宋州急，遣行周歸鎮。
units.en: When the Khitan entered Bian, he was summoned to the capital. Bandits were pressing Songzhou hard, so he was sent back to his post.
units.literal: When the Khitan entered Bian, he was summoned to the capital; bandits were pressing Songzhou hard, so Xingzhou was sent back to his commandery.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·高懷德傳》：杜重威降契丹，京東諸州群盜大起，懷德堅壁清野，敵不能入，行周率兵歸鎮，敵遂解去。）〉
units.en: (From the Biography of Gao Huaide in the 《History of Song》: When Du Chongwei surrendered to the Khitan, bandits rose everywhere across the eastern capital region. Huaide fortified the walls and cleared the countryside so the enemy could not break in. Xingzhou led his troops back to his post, and the enemy then withdrew.)〉
units.literal: (From the Biography of Gao Huaide in the 《History of Song》: When Du Chongwei surrendered to the Khitan, bandits rose everywhere in the eastern capital region. Huaide fortified the walls and cleared the countryside so the enemy could not enter; Xingzhou led troops back to his commandery, and the enemy then withdrew.)〉

units.zh: 及契丹主死於欒城，契丹將蕭翰立許王李從益知南朝軍國事，遣死士召行周，辭之以疾，退謂人曰：「衰世難輔，況兒戲乎！」
units.en: When the Khitan ruler died at Luancheng, the Khitan general Xiao Han installed Prince Xu Li Congyi to oversee the southern court's military and civil affairs and sent picked warriors to summon Xingzhou. He pleaded illness and declined. In private he said, "A dying age is hard to serve—how much less a child's game!"
units.literal: When the Khitan ruler died at Luancheng, the Khitan general Xiao Han installed Prince Xu Li Congyi to oversee the military and state affairs of the southern court and sent death-defying warriors to summon Xingzhou. He declined on grounds of illness and said privately to others, "A declining age is hard to serve—how much more a child's game!"

units.zh: 漢高祖入汴，加守太傅、兼中書令，代李守貞為天平節度使。
units.en: When Emperor Gaozu of Han entered Bian, Xingzhou was made acting Grand Tutor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, replacing Li Shouzhen as military commissioner of the Tianping circuit.
units.literal: When Emperor Gaozu of Han entered Bian, Xingzhou was made acting Grand Tutor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, replacing Li Shouzhen as military commissioner of the Tianping circuit.

units.zh: 杜重威據鄴叛，漢祖以行周為招討使，總兵討之。
units.en: When Du Chongwei held Ye and rebelled, the founding emperor of Han made Xingzhou pacification commissioner and entrusted him with total command to suppress the rebellion.
units.literal: When Du Chongwei held Ye and rebelled, the founding emperor of Han made Xingzhou pacification commissioner and entrusted him with total command to suppress the rebellion.

units.zh: 鄴平，授鄴都留守，加守太尉，進爵臨清王。
units.en: After Ye was pacified, he was made regent of the Ye capital, made acting Grand Commandant, and advanced in rank to Prince of Linqing.
units.literal: After Ye was pacified, he was made regent of the Ye capital, made acting Grand Commandant, and advanced in rank to Prince of Linqing.

units.zh: 乾祐中，入覲，加守太師，進封鄴王，復授天平節鉞，改封齊王。
units.en: In the Qianyou era he came to court, was made acting Grand Preceptor, was advanced to Prince of Ye, was again granted the Tianping commissioner seal and command, and was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.
units.literal: In the Qianyou era he came to court, was made acting Grand Preceptor, was advanced to Prince of Ye, was again granted the Tianping commissioner seal and command, and was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.

units.zh: 太祖踐阼，加守尚書令，增食邑至一萬七千戶。
units.en: When the founding emperor took the throne, Xingzhou was made acting Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and his stipendary households were increased to seventeen thousand.
units.literal: When the founding emperor took the throne, Xingzhou was made acting Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and his stipendary households were increased to seventeen thousand.

units.zh: 太祖以行周耆年宿將，賜詔不名，但呼王位而已。
units.en: Because Xingzhou was an old commander of advanced years, the founding emperor granted an edict that he should not be named in summons but addressed only by his princely title.
units.literal: Because Xingzhou was an old commander of advanced years, the founding emperor granted an edict that he should not be named in summons but addressed only by his princely title.

units.zh: 慕容彥超據兗叛，太祖親征，奉迎輿駕，傾家載贄，奉觴進俎，率以身先，太祖待之逾厚。
units.en: When Murong Yanchao held Yan and rebelled, the founding emperor campaigned in person. Xingzhou came out to welcome the imperial carriage, emptied his household to load tribute gifts, offered cups and served viands, always leading by personal example, and the founding emperor treated him with still greater favor.
units.literal: When Murong Yanchao held Yan and rebelled, the founding emperor campaigned in person. Xingzhou came out to welcome the imperial carriage, emptied his household to load tribute gifts, offered cups and served viands, always leading by personal example, and the founding emperor treated him with still greater favor.

units.zh: 廣順二年秋，以疾薨於位，享年六十八。
units.en: In autumn of the second year of Guangshun he died in office of illness at age sixty-eight.
units.literal: In autumn of the second year of Guangshun he died in office of illness at age sixty-eight.

units.zh: 赗賻加等，冊贈尚書令，追封秦王，謚曰武懿。
units.en: Funeral gifts were increased by one grade. By patent he was posthumously honored as Director of the Secretariat, enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Qin, and given the posthumous title Wuyi.
units.literal: Funeral gifts were increased by one grade. By patent he was posthumously honored as Director of the Secretariat, enfeoffed posthumously as Prince of Qin, and given the posthumous title Wuyi.

units.zh: 子懷德，皇朝駙馬都尉、宋州節度使。
units.en: His son Huaide served the present dynasty as imperial son-in-law and military commissioner of Songzhou.
units.literal: His son Huaide was imperial son-in-law and military commissioner of Songzhou in the present dynasty.

units.zh: 安審琦，字國瑞，其先沙陀部人也。
units.en: An Shenqi, whose courtesy name was Guorui, was descended from the Shatuo tribe.
units.literal: An Shenqi, courtesy name Guorui, was by origin of the Shatuo tribe.

units.zh: 祖山盛，朔州牢城都校，贈太傅。
units.en: His grandfather Shansheng had been commandant of the Laocheng garrison in Shuozhou and was posthumously honored as Grand Tutor.
units.literal: His grandfather Shansheng was commandant of the Laocheng garrison in Shuozhou and was posthumously honored as Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 父金全，安北都護、振武軍節度使，累贈太師，《唐書》有傳。
units.en: His father Jinquan had been protector-general of Anbei and military commissioner of the Zhenwu Army and was repeatedly posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor. He has a biography in the 《Book of Tang》.
units.literal: His father Jinquan was protector-general of Anbei and military commissioner of the Zhenwu Army, repeatedly posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor; he has a biography in the 《Book of Tang》.

units.zh: 審琦性驍果，善騎射，幼以良家子事莊宗為義直軍使，遷本軍指揮使。
units.en: Shenqi was bold and resolute by nature and excelled at horsemanship and archery. As a youth from a good family he entered Zhuangzong's service as commissioner of the Yizhi Army and rose to command that army.
units.literal: Shenqi was bold and resolute by nature and skilled in horsemanship and archery. As a youth, as a son of a good family he served Zhuangzong as commissioner of the Yizhi Army and was promoted to commander of that army.

units.zh: 天成初，唐末帝由潞邸出鎮河中，奏審琦為牙兵都校，未幾，入為歸化指揮使。
units.en: Early in Tiancheng, when the Last Emperor of Tang left the Lu residence to take up the Hezhong command, he recommended Shenqi as chief of the guard troops. Before long Shenqi entered court as commander of the Guihua Army.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tiancheng, the Last Emperor of Tang left the Lu residence to govern Hezhong and recommended Shenqi as chief of the guard troops; before long he entered court as commander of the Guihua Army.

units.zh: 王師伐蜀，充行營馬軍都指揮使，及凱旋，改龍武右廂都校，領富州刺史。
units.en: When the imperial army marched against Shu, he served as commander of the field headquarters cavalry. After the victorious return he was made chief of the right wing of the Dragon Martial Army and given charge of Fuzhou.
units.literal: When the imperial army campaigned against Shu, he served as commander of the field headquarters cavalry; upon the triumphant return he was made chief of the right wing of the Dragon Martial Army and given charge of Fuzhou.

units.zh: 清泰初，為捧聖指揮使，領順化軍節度使。
units.en: Early in Qingtai he was made commander of the Sacred Guard and military commissioner of the Shunhua Army.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingtai he was made commander of the Sacred Guard and military commissioner of the Shunhua Army.

units.zh: 其年鎮邢州，兼北面行營排軍陣使，從張敬達圍太原。
units.en: That same year he governed Xingzhou and also served as northern field headquarters battle-array commander, following Zhang Jingda in the siege of Taiyuan.
units.literal: That year he governed Xingzhou and concurrently served as northern field headquarters battle-array commander, following Zhang Jingda in besieging Taiyuan.

units.zh: 及楊光遠舉晉安寨降於晉祖，審琦亦預焉。
units.en: When Yang Guangyuan surrendered Jin'an stockade to the founding emperor of Jin, Shenqi was among those who went over with him.
units.literal: When Yang Guangyuan surrendered Jin'an stockade to the founding emperor of Jin, Shenqi took part as well.

units.zh: 晉祖踐阼，加檢校太傅、同平章事，充天平軍節度使兼侍衛馬步軍都指揮使，旋以母喪起復。
units.en: When the founding emperor of Jin took the throne, Shenqi was made honorary Grand Tutor and co-equal to the Secretariat-Chancellery, appointed military commissioner of the Tianping Army and commander of the palace horse and foot armies. He was soon recalled from mourning for his mother.
units.literal: When the founding emperor of Jin took the throne, Shenqi was made honorary Grand Tutor and co-equal to the Secretariat-Chancellery, appointed military commissioner of the Tianping Army and commander of the palace horse and foot armies, and soon recalled from mourning for his mother.

units.zh: 天福三年，就加檢校太尉，尋改晉昌軍節度使、京兆尹。
units.en: In the third year of Tianfu he was further made honorary Grand Commandant and soon transferred to military commissioner of the Jinchang Army and metropolitan governor of Jingzhao.
units.literal: In the third year of Tianfu he was further made honorary Grand Commandant and soon transferred to military commissioner of the Jinchang Army and metropolitan governor of Jingzhao.

units.zh: 七年，移鎮河中。
units.en: In the seventh year he was transferred to Hezhong.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to govern Hezhong.

units.zh: 晉少帝嗣位，加檢校太師。
units.en: When the young emperor of Jin succeeded, he was made honorary Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: When the young emperor of Jin succeeded, he was made honorary Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 開運末，朝廷以北戎入寇，以審琦為北面行營馬軍左右廂都指揮使，與諸將會兵於洺州。
units.en: Late in Kaiyun, with the northern barbarians invading, the court appointed Shenqi commander of the left and right wings of the northern field headquarters cavalry. He joined the other generals in assembling troops at Mingzhou.
units.literal: At the end of Kaiyun the court, because the northern barbarians had invaded, appointed Shenqi commander of the left and right wings of the northern field headquarters cavalry, and he joined the generals in assembling troops at Mingzhou.

units.zh: 俄而敵騎大至，時皇甫遇、慕容彥超亦預其行，乃率所部兵與敵戰於安陽河上。
units.en: Before long the enemy cavalry arrived in force. Huangfu Yu and Murong Yanchao were also on the march, and he led his troops to fight the enemy on the Anyang River.
units.literal: Soon the enemy cavalry arrived in force. Huangfu Yu and Murong Yanchao were also on the campaign, and he led his troops to fight the enemy on the Anyang River.

units.zh: 時遇馬為流矢所中，勢已危蹙，諸將相顧，莫有敢救者。
units.en: Yu's horse was struck by a stray arrow, and the situation was already desperate. The generals looked at one another, but none dared go to his aid.
units.literal: At that time Yu's horse was struck by a stray arrow; the situation was already desperate, and the generals looked at one another—none dared to rescue him.

units.zh: 審琦謂首將張從恩曰：「皇甫遇等未至，必為敵騎所圍，若不急救，則為擒矣。」
units.en: Shenqi said to the chief general Zhang Congen, "Huangfu Yu and the others have not yet come up. The enemy cavalry will surely surround them. If we do not rescue them at once, they will be taken."
units.literal: Shenqi said to the chief general Zhang Congen, "Huangfu Yu and the others have not yet arrived and will surely be surrounded by the enemy cavalry; if we do not rescue them at once, they will be captured."

units.zh: 從恩曰：「敵勢甚盛，無以枝梧，將軍獨往何益？」
units.en: Congen said, "The enemy is too strong for us to hold. What good will it do if you go alone, General?"
units.literal: Congen said, "The enemy's strength is overwhelming; we have no way to resist. What good will it do if you go alone, General?"

units.zh: 審琦曰：「成敗命也，若不濟，與之俱死，假令失此二將，何面目以見天子！」
units.en: Shenqi said, "Success or failure is in heaven's hands. If we fail, I shall die with them. If we lose these two generals, what face will we have when we see the Son of Heaven!"
units.literal: Shenqi said, "Success or failure is fate's decree; if we do not succeed, I shall die with them. If we lose these two generals, what face shall we have to see the Son of Heaven!"

units.zh: 遂率鐵騎北渡。
units.en: He then led his iron cavalry north across the river.
units.literal: He then led his iron cavalry north across the river.

units.zh: 敵見塵起，謂救兵至，乃引去。
units.en: The enemy saw the dust rising and thought relief troops had arrived, so they withdrew.
units.literal: The enemy saw the dust rise and thought relief troops had arrived, so they withdrew.

units.zh: 遂救遇與彥超而還。
units.en: He rescued Yu and Yanchao and returned with them.
units.literal: He thus rescued Yu and Yanchao and returned.

units.zh: 晉少帝嘉之，加兼侍中，移領許州，未幾，移鎮兗海。
units.en: The young emperor of Jin praised his deed, additionally made him Palace Attendant, transferred him to Xuzhou, and before long moved him to Yanhai.
units.literal: The young emperor of Jin praised him, additionally made him Palace Attendant, transferred him to lead Xuzhou, and before long moved him to govern Yanhai.

units.zh: 漢有天下，授襄州節度使、兼中書令。
units.en: When the Han dynasty held the realm, he was appointed military commissioner of Xiangzhou and concurrently Secretariat Director.
units.literal: When Han held the realm, he was appointed military commissioner of Xiangzhou and concurrently Secretariat Director.

units.zh: 屬荊人叛命，潛遣舟師數千屠襄、郢，審琦禦之而遁，朝廷賞功，就加守太保，進封齊國公。
units.en: When the people of Jing rebelled, they secretly sent several thousand warships to sack Xiang and Ying. Shenqi drove them off, and the court rewarded his merit by immediately making him acting Grand Guardian and advancing him to Duke of Qi.
units.literal: When the people of Jing rebelled, they secretly sent several thousand warships to sack Xiang and Ying; Shenqi resisted them and they fled. The court rewarded his merit, immediately added the title of acting Grand Guardian, and advanced him to Duke of Qi.

units.zh: 歲餘，又加守太傅。
units.en: A little more than a year later he was further made acting Grand Tutor.
units.literal: After more than a year he was further made acting Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 國初，封南陽王。
units.en: At the founding of the dynasty he was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanyang.
units.literal: At the beginning of the dynasty he was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanyang.

units.zh: 顯德初，進封陳王。
units.en: Early in Xiande he was advanced to Prince of Chen.
units.literal: At the beginning of Xiande he was advanced to Prince of Chen.

units.zh: 世宗嗣位，加守太尉。
units.en: When Shizong succeeded, he was made acting Grand Commandant.
units.literal: When Shizong succeeded, he was made acting Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 三年，拜章請覲，優詔許之，加守太師，增食邑至一萬五百戶，食實封二千三百戶。
units.en: In the third year he submitted a memorial asking to come to court. An edict graciously granted his request, made him acting Grand Preceptor, increased his fief to ten thousand five hundred households, and gave him two thousand three hundred actual fief households.
units.literal: In the third year he submitted a memorial requesting an audience; an imperial edict graciously permitted it, made him acting Grand Preceptor, increased his fief to ten thousand five hundred households, and gave him two thousand three hundred actual fief households.

units.zh: 審琦鎮襄、沔僅一紀，嚴而不殘，威而不暴，故南邦之民甚懷其惠。
units.en: Shenqi governed Xiang and Mian for nearly twelve years. He was strict but not cruel, awe-inspiring but not violent, and the people of the south deeply cherished his kindness.
units.literal: Shenqi governed Xiang and Mian for nearly twelve years, strict but not cruel, awe-inspiring but not violent, so the people of the southern regions deeply cherished his kindness.

units.zh: 五年，移平盧軍節度使，承詔赴鎮，因朝於京師，世宗以國之元老，禮遇甚厚，車駕親幸其第以寵之。
units.en: In the fifth year he was transferred to military commissioner of the Pinglu Army. He received the edict and set out for his post, stopping at the capital on the way to pay court. Shizong treated him, as an elder statesman of the realm, with exceptional courtesy, and the emperor himself visited his residence to honor him.
units.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to military commissioner of the Pinglu Army; he received the edict and went to his commandery, and on the way paid court at the capital. Shizong, regarding him as an elder statesman of the realm, treated him with great courtesy; the imperial carriage personally visited his residence to honor him.

units.zh: 六年正月七日夜，為其隸人安友進、安萬合所害，時年六十三。
units.en: On the night of the seventh day of the first month of the sixth year he was murdered by his retainers An Youjin and An Wanhe. He was sixty-three.
units.literal: On the night of the seventh day of the first month of the sixth year he was killed by his retainers An Youjin and An Wanhe; he was sixty-three.

units.zh: 初，友進與審琦之愛妾私通，有年數矣。
units.en: Earlier, Youjin had been carrying on a secret affair with Shenqi's favorite concubine for several years.
units.literal: Earlier, Youjin had carried on a secret affair with Shenqi's favorite concubine for several years.

units.zh: 其妾常慮事泄見誅，因與友進謀害審琦，友進甚有難色。
units.en: The concubine constantly feared that if the affair came out she would be executed, so she plotted with Youjin to kill Shenqi. Youjin was deeply reluctant.
units.literal: The concubine constantly feared that if the affair were exposed she would be put to death, so she plotted with Youjin to kill Shenqi; Youjin showed great reluctance.

units.zh: 其妾曰：「爾若不從，我當反告。」
units.en: The concubine said, "If you refuse, I shall turn and inform on you instead."
units.literal: The concubine said, "If you do not agree, I shall inform on you instead."

units.zh: 友進乃許之。
units.en: Youjin then agreed.
units.literal: Youjin then agreed.

units.zh: 至是夕，審琦沈醉，寢於帳中，其妾乃取審琦所枕劍與友進，友進猶惶駭不敢剚刃，遽召其黨安萬合，便殺審琦。
units.en: That night Shenqi was drunk and asleep in his tent. The concubine took the sword he kept under his pillow and gave it to Youjin. Youjin was still terrified and did not dare strike, so he hastily summoned his accomplice An Wanhe, and together they killed Shenqi.
units.literal: On that night Shenqi was deeply drunk and slept in his tent; the concubine took the sword Shenqi kept under his pillow and gave it to Youjin. Youjin was still terrified and did not dare draw the blade, so he hastily summoned his accomplice An Wanhe, and they killed Shenqi.

units.zh: 既而慮事泄，乃引其帳下數妓，盡殺以滅其跡。
units.en: Then, fearing the affair would come out, they brought several singing girls from the tent and killed them all to destroy the evidence.
units.literal: Then, fearing the affair would leak out, they brought several singing girls from the tent and killed them all to destroy the evidence.

units.zh: 不數日，友進等竟敗，悉為子守忠臠而戮之。
units.en: Within a few days Youjin and the others were exposed and defeated. Shenqi's son Shouzhong had them all dismembered and executed.
units.literal: Within a few days Youjin and the others were at last defeated and were all dismembered and executed by his son Shouzhong.

units.zh: 世宗聞之震悼，輟視朝三日，詔贈尚書令，追封齊王。
units.en: When Shizong heard the news he was shaken with grief, suspended court for three days, and by edict posthumously honored Shenqi as Director of the Imperial Secretariat and enfeoffed him posthumously as King of Qi.
units.literal: When Shizong heard of it he was shaken with grief, suspended court audiences for three days, and by edict posthumously honored Shenqi as Director of the Imperial Secretariat and enfeoffed him posthumously as King of Qi.

units.zh: 守忠仕皇朝，累為郡守。
units.en: Shouzhong served the present dynasty and repeatedly held prefectural governorships.
units.literal: Shouzhong served the present dynasty and repeatedly held prefectural governorships.

units.zh: 安審暉，字明遠，審琦之兄也。
units.en: An Shenhui, whose courtesy name was Mingyuan, was Shenqi's elder brother.
units.literal: An Shenhui, courtesy name Mingyuan, was Shenqi's elder brother.

units.zh: 起家自長直軍使，轉外衙左廂軍使。
units.en: He began his career as commissioner of the Changzhi Army and rose to command the left wing of the outer guard.
units.literal: He began his career as commissioner of the Changzhi Army and was transferred to commander of the left wing of the outer guard.

units.zh: 從莊宗平幽、薊，戰山東，定河南，皆預其功。
units.en: He followed Zhuangzong in pacifying You and Ji, fought in Shandong, and helped settle Henan, distinguishing himself in each campaign.
units.literal: He followed Zhuangzong in pacifying You and Ji, fought in Shandong, and settled Henan—all with merit.

units.zh: 同光中，授蔚州刺史。
units.en: During the Tongguang era he was appointed governor of Weizhou.
units.literal: During the Tongguang era he was appointed governor of Weizhou.

units.zh: 天成初，改汝州防禦副使，歷鳳翔徐州節度副使、河東行軍司馬。
units.en: Early in Tiancheng he was made deputy defense commissioner of Ruzhou, then served successively as deputy military commissioner of Fengxiang and Xuzhou and as field headquarters marshal of Hedong.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tiancheng he was made deputy defense commissioner of Ruzhou, then served successively as deputy military commissioner of Fengxiang and Xuzhou and as field headquarters marshal of Hedong.

units.zh: 晉高祖龍飛，以霸府上僚授振武兵馬留後，遷河陽節度使，不逾月移鎮鄜州，丁內艱，起復視事。
units.en: When the high ancestor of Jin took the throne, as a senior official of the hegemon's residence he was appointed acting commander of the Zhenwu army and cavalry, made military commissioner of Heyang, and within a month transferred to Fuzhou. He went into mourning for his mother but was soon recalled to duty.
units.literal: When the high ancestor of Jin ascended, as a senior official of the hegemon's residence he was appointed acting commander of the Zhenwu army and cavalry, transferred to military commissioner of Heyang, and within a month moved to govern Fuzhou; he mourned his mother but was recalled to office.

units.zh: 五年，李金全據安州叛，詔馬全節為都部署，領兵討之，以審暉為副。
units.en: In the fifth year Li Jinquan seized Anzhou and rebelled. Ma Quanjie was appointed overall commander to lead the campaign, with Shenhui as his deputy.
units.literal: In the fifth year Li Jinquan seized Anzhou and rebelled; Ma Quanjie was ordered overall commander to lead troops against him, with Shenhui as deputy.

units.zh: 安睦平，移鎮鄧州，進位檢校太傅。
units.en: After An and Mu were pacified, he was transferred to Dengzhou and promoted to honorary Grand Tutor.
units.literal: When An and Mu were pacified, he was transferred to Dengzhou and advanced to honorary Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 六年冬，襄州安從進叛，舉漢南之眾北攻南陽。
units.en: In the winter of the sixth year An Congjin of Xiangzhou rebelled and led the armies of southern Han north against Nanyang.
units.literal: In the winter of the sixth year An Congjin of Xiangzhou rebelled and led the forces of south Han north to attack Nanyang.

units.zh: 南陽素無城壁，唯守衙城，賊傅城下，審暉登陴，召賊帥以讓之，從進不克而退。
units.en: Nanyang had never had proper walls and held only the yamen compound. When the rebels pressed the walls, Shenhui mounted the battlements, summoned the rebel leader, and rebuked him. Congjin failed to take the city and withdrew.
units.literal: Nanyang had long lacked walls and defended only the yamen city; the rebels pressed against the walls. Shenhui mounted the battlements, summoned the rebel leader, and rebuked him; Congjin could not take the city and withdrew.

units.zh: 襄州平，就加檢校太尉。
units.en: When Xiangzhou was pacified, he was immediately made honorary Grand Commandant.
units.literal: When Xiangzhou was pacified, he was immediately made honorary Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 少帝嗣位，加檢校太師，罷鎮，授右羽林統軍。
units.en: When the young emperor succeeded, he was made honorary Grand Preceptor, relieved of his post, and appointed commander of the Right Feathered Forest.
units.literal: When the young emperor succeeded, he was made honorary Grand Preceptor, relieved of his commandery, and appointed commander of the Right Feathered Forest.

units.zh: 歲餘，出鎮上黨，屬契丹內侵，授邢州節度使。
units.en: A little more than a year later he was sent out to govern Shangdang. When the Khitan invaded, he was appointed military commissioner of Xingzhou.
units.literal: After more than a year he went out to govern Shangdang; when the Khitan invaded within the realm, he was appointed military commissioner of Xingzhou.

units.zh: 居無何，目疾暴作，上章求代，歸於京師，養疾累年。
units.en: Before long he was stricken with a sudden eye ailment. He submitted a memorial asking to be replaced, returned to the capital, and spent years convalescing.
units.literal: Before long an eye ailment suddenly struck; he submitted a memorial requesting a replacement, returned to the capital, and nursed his illness for years.

units.zh: 太祖即位，召於內殿，從容顧問，尤所嘆重。
units.en: When Taizu took the throne, he summoned Shenhui to the inner hall, spoke with him at length, and held him in special esteem.
units.literal: When Taizu took the throne, he summoned Shenhui to the inner hall, questioned him at ease, and especially admired him.

units.zh: 將以祿起之，審暉辭以暮齒，願就頤養。
units.en: Taizu was about to recall him to office with salary and rank, but Shenhui declined on account of his advanced years and asked to live out his days in quiet retirement.
units.literal: Taizu was about to raise him with salary and office, but Shenhui declined on account of his advanced years and wished to retire to nurture his health.

units.zh: 拜太子太師致仕，封魯國公，累食邑五千戶，實封四百戶。
units.en: He was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired, enfeoffed as Duke of Lu, with a cumulative fief of five thousand households and four hundred actual fief households.
units.literal: He was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired, enfeoffed as Duke of Lu, with a cumulative fief of five thousand households and four hundred actual fief households.

units.zh: 廣順二年春卒，年六十三。
units.en: He died in the spring of the second year of Guangshun, aged sixty-three.
units.literal: He died in the spring of the second year of Guangshun, aged sixty-three.

units.zh: 廢朝二日，詔贈侍中，謚曰靜。
units.en: Court was suspended for two days. By edict he was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant and given the posthumous name Jing.
units.literal: Court was suspended for two days; by edict he was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant, with the posthumous name Jing.

units.zh: 子守鏻，仕皇朝為贊善大夫。
units.en: His son Shoulian served the present dynasty as gentleman attendant.
units.literal: His son Shoulian served the present dynasty as gentleman attendant.

units.zh: 安審信，字行光，審琦之從父兄也。
units.en: An Shenxin, whose courtesy name was Xingguang, was Shenqi's elder cousin.
units.literal: An Shenxin, courtesy name Xingguang, was Shenqi's elder cousin.

units.zh: 父金祐，世為沙陀部偏裨，名聞邊塞。
units.en: His father Jinyou had for generations served the Shatuo as a junior officer, and his name was known on the frontier.
units.literal: His father Jinyou had for generations been a junior officer of the Shatuo tribe, his name known on the frontier.

units.zh: 審信習騎射。
units.en: Shenxin trained in horsemanship and archery.
units.literal: Shenxin practiced horsemanship and archery.

units.zh: 從父金全，天成初，為振武節度使，補為牙將。
units.en: His cousin Jinquan was military commissioner of Zhenwu early in Tiancheng, and Shenxin was appointed a guard officer in his retinue.
units.literal: His cousin Jinquan, at the beginning of Tiancheng, was military commissioner of Zhenwu, and Shenxin was appointed a guard officer under him.

units.zh: 俄而兄審通為滄州節度使，用為衙內都虞候，歷同、陜、許三州馬步軍都指揮使。
units.en: Soon his elder brother Shentong became military commissioner of Cangzhou and made him deputy commander of the inner guard. He then served successively as commander of the horse and foot armies of Tong, Shan, and Xu.
units.literal: Soon his elder brother Shentong became military commissioner of Cangzhou and employed him as deputy commander of the inner guard; he then served successively as commander of the horse and foot armies of Tong, Shan, and Xu.

units.zh: 晉祖起義於太原，唐末帝命張敬達以兵攻之，而審信率先以部下兵遁入并州，晉祖以其故人，得之甚悅。
units.en: When the founding emperor of Jin raised his banner at Taiyuan, the Last Emperor of Tang sent Zhang Jingda against him. Shenxin was the first to defect with his troops into Bingzhou. The founding emperor of Jin, recognizing an old acquaintance, was greatly pleased.
units.literal: When the founding emperor of Jin raised the righteous cause at Taiyuan, the Last Emperor of Tang ordered Zhang Jingda to attack with troops; Shenxin was the first to flee with his men into Bingzhou. The founding emperor of Jin, because he was an old acquaintance, was greatly pleased to receive him.

units.zh: 其妻與二子在京師，皆為唐末帝所戮，但貸其老母而已。
units.en: His wife and two sons in the capital were all executed by the Last Emperor of Tang. Only his aged mother was spared.
units.literal: His wife and two sons in the capital were all executed by the Last Emperor of Tang; only his aged mother was spared.

units.zh: 契丹既降晉安寨，晉高祖以審信為汾州刺史、檢校太保，充馬步軍副部署。
units.en: After the Khitan reduced Jin'an stockade, the high ancestor of Jin appointed Shenxin governor of Fenzhou and honorary Grand Guardian and made him deputy commander of the horse and foot armies.
units.literal: After the Khitan reduced Jin'an stockade, the high ancestor of Jin appointed Shenxin governor of Fenzhou and honorary Grand Guardian and made him deputy commander of the horse and foot armies.

units.zh: 晉祖入洛，授河中節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事。
units.en: When the founding emperor of Jin entered Luoyang, he made Shenxin military commissioner of Hezhong, honorary Grand Commandant, and co-equal to the Secretariat-Chancellery.
units.literal: When the founding emperor of Jin entered Luoyang, he appointed Shenxin military commissioner of Hezhong, honorary Grand Commandant, and co-equal to the Secretariat-Chancellery.

units.zh: 審信性既翻覆，率多疑忌，在蒲中時，每王人告諭，騎從稍多，必潛設備，以防其圖己。
units.en: Shenxin was fickle by nature and habitually suspicious. While at Puzhong, whenever imperial envoys arrived, if their mounted escort was even slightly large he would secretly take precautions, fearing a plot against him.
units.literal: Shenxin's nature was fickle and he was habitually suspicious and jealous. While at Puzhong, whenever imperial envoys came to instruct him, if their mounted escort was even slightly large he would secretly take precautions against a plot against himself.

units.zh: 尋歷許、兗州鎮，所至以聚斂為務，民甚苦之。
units.en: Soon he governed Xu and Yan in succession. Wherever he went he made exaction his chief business, and the people suffered greatly.
units.literal: Soon he governed Xu and Yan in succession; wherever he went he made exaction his business, and the people suffered greatly.

units.zh: 會朝廷謀大舉北伐，凡藩侯皆預將帥，以審信為馬步軍右廂都排陣使，俄改華州節度使。
units.en: When the court planned a major northern campaign, all the regional lords were named among the commanders. Shenxin was made overall battle-array commander of the right wing of the horse and foot armies and soon was made military commissioner of Huazhou.
units.literal: When the court planned a major northern campaign, all the regional lords were included among the commanders; Shenxin was made overall battle-array commander of the right wing of the horse and foot armies, and soon was made military commissioner of Huazhou.

units.zh: 漢初，移鎮同州，入為左衛上將軍。
units.en: Early in the Han dynasty he was transferred to Tongzhou and then entered court as general of the Left Guard.
units.literal: At the beginning of Han he was transferred to Tongzhou and entered court as general of the Left Guard.

units.zh: 國初，轉右金吾上將軍。
units.en: At the founding of the dynasty he was transferred to general of the Right Golden Crow.
units.literal: At the founding of the dynasty he was transferred to general of the Right Golden Crow.

units.zh: 三年夏四月，太祖禦乾元殿入閣，審信不赴班位，為御史所彈，詔釋之。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer of the third year Taizu held court at the Qianyuan Hall for the inner audience. Shenxin failed to take his place in the ranks and was impeached by the censorate, but an edict pardoned him.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the third year Taizu held court at the Qianyuan Hall for the inner audience; Shenxin did not take his place in the ranks and was impeached by the censorate, but an edict pardoned him.

units.zh: 時審信久病，神情恍惚，聞臺司奏劾，揚言曰：「趨朝偶晚，未是大過，何用彈舉！
units.en: Shenxin had long been ill and his mind was clouded. When he heard of the censorate's impeachment he declared aloud, "Arriving at court a little late is no great fault. Why impeach me!
units.literal: At that time Shenxin had long been ill and his mind was clouded; when he heard of the censorate's impeachment he declared aloud, "Arriving at court a little late is no great fault—why impeach me!

units.zh: 我終進奉二萬緡，盡逐此乞索兒輩。」
units.en: I will eventually present twenty thousand strings of cash and drive out all these beggarly fellows."
units.literal: I will eventually present twenty thousand strings of cash and drive out all these beggarly fellows."

units.zh: 未幾，以病請退，授太子太師致仕。
units.en: Before long he requested retirement on grounds of illness and was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired.
units.literal: Before long, on grounds of illness he requested retirement and was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired.

units.zh: 是歲秋卒，年六十。
units.en: He died that autumn, aged sixty.
units.literal: He died that autumn, aged sixty.

units.zh: 贈侍中，謚曰成穆。
units.en: He was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant and given the posthumous name Chengnu.
units.literal: He was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant, with the posthumous name Chengnu.

units.zh: 李從敏，字叔達，唐明宗之猶子也。
units.en: Li Congmin, whose courtesy name was Shuda, was a nephew of Emperor Mingzong of Tang.
units.literal: Li Congmin, courtesy name Shuda, was a nephew of Emperor Mingzong of Tang.

units.zh: 沈厚寡言，善騎射，多計數。
units.en: He was deep and taciturn, skilled in horsemanship and archery, and full of stratagems.
units.literal: He was deep and taciturn, skilled in horsemanship and archery, and full of stratagems.

units.zh: 初，莊宗召見，試弓馬，用為衙內馬軍指揮使，從平汴、洛，補帳前都指揮使，遷捧聖都將。
units.en: At first Zhuangzong summoned him, tested his bow and horsemanship, and made him commander of the inner guard cavalry. He followed in pacifying Bian and Luo, was appointed commander before the tent, and rose to colonel of the Sacred Guard.
units.literal: At first Zhuangzong summoned him, tested his bow and horsemanship, and employed him as commander of the inner guard cavalry; he followed in pacifying Bian and Luo, was appointed commander before the tent, and was promoted to colonel of the Sacred Guard.

units.zh: 明宗移鎮真定，表為成德軍馬步軍都指揮使。
units.en: When Mingzong moved his command to Zhending, he recommended Congmin as commander of the horse and foot armies of the Chengde Army.
units.literal: When Mingzong moved his command to Zhending, he recommended Congmin as commander of the horse and foot armies of the Chengde Army.

units.zh: 從明宗入洛，補皇城使，出為陜府節度使。
units.en: He followed Mingzong into Luoyang, was appointed commissioner of the Imperial City, and was then sent out as military commissioner of the Shan prefecture.
units.literal: He followed Mingzong into Luoyang, was appointed commissioner of the Imperial City, and went out as military commissioner of the Shan prefecture.

units.zh: 王都據定州叛，命王晏球為招討使，率師討之，以從敏為副，領滄州節度使。
units.en: When Wang Du held Dingzhou and rebelled, Wang Yanqiu was appointed pacification commissioner to lead the campaign, with Congmin as his deputy and concurrent military commissioner of Cangzhou.
units.literal: When Wang Du held Dingzhou and rebelled, Wang Yanqiu was ordered pacification commissioner to lead troops against him, with Congmin as deputy and concurrent military commissioner of Cangzhou.

units.zh: 王都平，移授定州。
units.en: After Wang Du was crushed, Congmin was transferred to Dingzhou.
units.literal: When Wang Du was pacified, Congmin was transferred to Dingzhou.

units.zh: 尋代範延光為成德軍節度使，加檢校太尉，封涇王。
units.en: Soon he replaced Fan Yanguang as military commissioner of the Chengde Army, was made honorary Grand Commandant, and enfeoffed as Prince of Jing.
units.literal: Soon he replaced Fan Yanguang as military commissioner of the Chengde Army, was made honorary Grand Commandant, and enfeoffed as Prince of Jing.

units.zh: 鎮州有市人劉方遇，家富於財。
units.en: In Zhenzhou there was a townsman named Liu Fangyu whose family was very wealthy.
units.literal: In Zhenzhou there was a townsman named Liu Fangyu whose family was rich in wealth.

units.zh: 方遇卒，無子。
units.en: Fangyu died without a son.
units.literal: Fangyu died without a son.

units.zh: 妻弟田令遵者，幼為方遇治財，善殖貨，劉族乃共推令遵為方遇子，親族共立券書，以為誓信。
units.en: His wife's younger brother Tian Lingzun had managed Fangyu's finances from youth and was skilled at increasing wealth. The Liu clan then jointly urged that Lingzun be adopted as Fangyu's son, and the kin drew up a written bond as sworn proof.
units.literal: His wife's younger brother Tian Lingzun had from youth managed Fangyu's finances and was skilled at increasing wealth; the Liu clan then jointly urged that Lingzun be made Fangyu's son, and the kin drew up a written bond as sworn proof.

units.zh: 累年後，方遇二女取資於令遵不如意，乃訟令遵冒姓，奪父家財，從敏令判官陸浣鞫其獄，而殺令遵。
units.en: Years later Fangyu's two daughters, dissatisfied with the funds they received from Lingzun, sued him for falsely taking the Liu surname and seizing their father's estate. Congmin ordered his judicial officer Lu Huan to try the case and had Lingzun executed.
units.literal: Years later Fangyu's two daughters, dissatisfied with the funds they received from Lingzun, sued him for falsely taking the Liu surname and seizing their father's family wealth. Congmin ordered his judicial officer Lu Huan to try the case and had Lingzun executed.

units.zh: 〈（《北夢瑣言》云：鎮州市人劉方遇，家財數十萬。
units.en: (The 《Miscellaneous Words of Northern Dreams》 says: Liu Fangyu, a townsman of Zhenzhou, had family wealth of several hundred thousand.
units.literal: (The 《Miscellaneous Words of Northern Dreams》 says: Liu Fangyu, a townsman of Zhenzhou, had family wealth of several hundred thousand.

units.zh: 方遇妻田氏蚤卒，田之妹為尼，常出入方遇家，方遇使尼長發為繼室。
units.en: Fangyu's wife, née Tian, died early. Tian's younger sister was a nun who often visited Fangyu's house. Fangyu had the nun let her hair grow long and made her his successor wife.
units.literal: Fangyu's wife, née Tian, died early; Tian's younger sister was a nun who often came and went in Fangyu's house, and Fangyu had the nun let her hair grow long and made her his successor wife.

units.zh: 有田令遵者，方遇之妻弟也，善貨殖，方遇以所積財令令遵興殖焉。
units.en: There was Tian Lingzun, Fangyu's wife's younger brother, skilled at trade. Fangyu entrusted his accumulated wealth to Lingzun to increase it.
units.literal: There was Tian Lingzun, Fangyu's wife's younger brother, skilled at trade; Fangyu put his accumulated wealth in Lingzun's hands to increase it.

units.zh: 方遇有子年幼，二女皆嫁。
units.en: Fangyu had a young son. Both daughters were already married.
units.literal: Fangyu had a young son; both daughters were married.

units.zh: 方遇疾卒，子幼不能督家業，方遇妻及二女以家財素為令遵興殖，乃聚族合謀，請以令遵姓劉，為方遇繼嗣，即令鬻券人安美為親族請嗣。
units.en: Fangyu died suddenly. The son was too young to manage the household. Because the family wealth had long been increased by Lingzun, Fangyu's wife and the two daughters gathered the clan in conspiracy and petitioned that Lingzun take the surname Liu as Fangyu's successor heir, with An Mei, who had drawn up the bond, petitioning the kin for the succession.
units.literal: Fangyu died suddenly of illness; the son was too young to oversee the household. Fangyu's wife and the two daughters, because the family wealth had long been increased by Lingzun, gathered the clan in conspiracy and petitioned that Lingzun take the surname Liu as Fangyu's successor heir, having An Mei, who had drawn up the bond, petition the kin for the succession.

units.zh: 券書既定，乃遣令遵服斬衰居喪。
units.en: Once the written bond was settled, they had Lingzun wear the hemmed sackcloth of mourning and observe the funeral rites.
units.literal: Once the written bond was settled, they had Lingzun wear the hemmed sackcloth of mourning and observe the funeral rites.

units.zh: 而二女初立令遵時，先邀每月供財二萬，及後求取無厭，而石、李二女夫使二女詣本府論訴，雲令遵冒姓，奪父家財，令遵下獄。
units.en: When the two daughters first established Lingzun, they had demanded twenty thousand in monthly support. Later their demands knew no limit. The husbands of the Shi and Li daughters sent the two daughters to the prefectural office to plead their case, saying Lingzun had falsely taken the surname and seized their father's estate. Lingzun was thrown into prison.
units.literal: When the two daughters first established Lingzun, they had first demanded twenty thousand in monthly support; later their demands were insatiable. The husbands of the Shi and Li daughters sent the two daughters to the prefectural office to plead their case, saying Lingzun had falsely taken the surname and seized their father's family wealth, and Lingzun was thrown into prison.

units.zh: 石、李二夫族與本府要吏親黨，上至府帥判官、行軍司馬、隨使都押衙，各受方遇二女賂錢數千緡，而以令遵與姊及書券安美同情共盜，俱棄市，人知其冤。）〉
units.en: The Shi and Li husbands' clans were kin to key officials of the prefecture, from the prefect's judicial officer and field headquarters marshal up to the chief military adjutant of the attendant mission. Each received several thousand strings in bribes from Fangyu's two daughters. Lingzun, his elder sister, and An Mei, who had drawn up the bond, were charged with conspiring to steal together and all were executed in the marketplace. People knew they had been wronged.)〉
units.literal: The Shi and Li husbands' clans were kin to key officials of the prefecture, up to the prefect's judicial officer, field headquarters marshal, and chief military adjutant of the attendant mission; each received several thousand strings in bribes from Fangyu's two daughters. Lingzun, his elder sister, and An Mei, who had drawn up the bond, were charged with conspiring to steal together and all were executed in the marketplace; people knew they were wronged.)〉

units.zh: 令遵父詣臺訴冤，詔本州節度副使符蒙、掌書記徐臺符鞫之，備明奸狀。
units.en: Lingzun's father appealed to the censorate to protest the injustice. An edict ordered the deputy military commissioner Fu Meng and chief secretary Xu Taifu to try the case and fully expose the corrupt conduct.
units.literal: Lingzun's father appealed to the censorate to protest the injustice; an edict ordered the deputy military commissioner of the prefecture Fu Meng and chief secretary Xu Taifu to try the case and fully expose the corrupt conduct.

units.zh: 及詰二女，伏行賂於節度使趙環、代判高知柔、觀察判官陸浣，並捕下獄，具服贓罪。
units.en: When the two daughters were questioned, they confessed to bribing the military commissioner Zhao Huan, acting judicial officer Gao Zhirou, and observation judicial officer Lu Huan. All were arrested and imprisoned and fully confessed their crimes of bribery.
units.literal: When the two daughters were questioned, they confessed to bribing the military commissioner Zhao Huan, acting judicial officer Gao Zhirou, and observation judicial officer Lu Huan; all were arrested and imprisoned and fully confessed their crimes of bribery.

units.zh: 事連從敏，甚懼，乃令其妻赴洛陽，入宮告王淑妃。
units.en: The affair implicated Congmin, who was greatly afraid. He sent his wife to Luoyang to enter the palace and appeal to Consort Wang Shufei.
units.literal: The affair implicated Congmin, who was greatly afraid; he therefore sent his wife to Luoyang to enter the palace and appeal to Consort Wang Shufei.

units.zh: 明宗知之，怒曰：「朕用從敏為節度使，而枉法殺人，我羞見百官，又令新婦奔赴，不須見吾面。」
units.en: When Mingzong learned of it he said in anger, "I made Congmin a military commissioner, yet he killed a man in violation of the law. I am ashamed to face my officials. To send his new wife rushing here—she need not see my face."
units.literal: When Mingzong learned of it he said in anger, "I employed Congmin as military commissioner, yet he killed a man in violation of the law. I am ashamed to face the officials. To send his new wife rushing here—she need not see my face."

units.zh: 時王淑妃頗庇護之，趙環等三人竟棄市，從敏等止於罰俸而已。
units.en: Consort Wang Shufei sheltered him considerably, but Zhao Huan and the other three were nevertheless executed in the marketplace. Congmin and the others were punished only by forfeiture of salary.
units.literal: At that time Consort Wang Shufei sheltered him considerably; Zhao Huan and the other three were nevertheless executed in the marketplace, while Congmin and the others were punished only by forfeiture of salary.

units.zh: 〈（《北夢瑣言》：從敏初欲削官，中宮哀祈，竟罰一年俸。）〉
units.en: (The 《Miscellaneous Words of Northern Dreams》: Congmin was at first to be stripped of office. The inner palace pleaded piteously on his behalf, and in the end he was fined one year's salary.)〉
units.literal: (The 《Miscellaneous Words of Northern Dreams》: Congmin was at first to be stripped of office; the inner palace pleaded piteously, and in the end he was fined one year's salary.)〉

units.zh: 長興初，移鎮宋州。
units.en: In the first year of Changxing he was transferred to command Songzhou.
units.literal: In the first year of Changxing, he was transferred to command Songzhou.

units.zh: 唐末帝起兵於鳳翔，其子重吉為亳州防禦使，從敏承朝廷命害之。
units.en: When the Last Emperor of Tang raised troops at Fengxiang, his son Chongji was defense commissioner of Bozhou. On court orders Congmin killed him.
units.literal: When the Last Emperor of Tang raised troops at Fengxiang, his son Chongji was defense commissioner of Bozhou; Congmin, on court orders, killed him.

units.zh: 清泰中，從敏與洋王從璋並罷歸第，待之甚薄。
units.en: In the Qingtai era Congmin and Prince Yang Congzhang were both dismissed and sent home, and he was treated very coldly.
units.literal: In the Qingtai era, Congmin and Prince Yang Congzhang were both dismissed and sent home, and he was treated very coldly.

units.zh: 嘗宮中同飲，既醉，末帝謂從璋、從敏曰：「爾等何物，處雄藩大鎮！」
units.en: Once they drank together in the palace and, when drunk, the Last Emperor said to Congzhang and Congmin, "What sort of things are you, to hold great frontier commands!"
units.literal: Once they drank together in the palace and, when drunk, the Last Emperor said to Congzhang and Congmin, "What sort of things are you, to hold great frontier commands!"

units.zh: 二人大懼，賴曹太后見之，叱曰：「官家醉，爾輩速出去！」
units.en: The two were greatly afraid. Thanks to Empress Dowager Cao's presence, she rebuked them, saying, "The sovereign is drunk. Get out at once!"
units.literal: The two were greatly afraid. Thanks to Empress Dowager Cao's presence, she rebuked them, saying, "The sovereign is drunk. Get out at once!"

units.zh: 方得解。
units.en: Only then were they released.
units.literal: Only then were they released.

units.zh: 晉祖革命，降封莒國公，再領陜州，尋移鎮上黨，入為右龍武統軍，出為河陽節度使。
units.en: When the founding emperor of Jin seized power, Congmin was demoted and enfeoffed as Duke of Ju. He again took charge of Shanzhou, soon moved to command Shangdang, entered court as commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, and went out as military commissioner of Heyang.
units.literal: When the founding emperor of Jin seized power, Congmin was demoted and enfeoffed as Duke of Ju, again took charge of Shanzhou, soon moved to command Shangdang, entered court as commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, and went out as military commissioner of Heyang.

units.zh: 漢祖入汴，移授西京留守，累官檢校太師、同平章事。
units.en: When the founding emperor of Han entered Bian, he was made western capital regent and cumulatively held the posts of honorary Grand Preceptor and co-equal to the Secretariat-Chancellery.
units.literal: When the founding emperor of Han entered Bian, he was transferred to western capital regent and cumulatively held the posts of honorary Grand Preceptor and co-equal to the Secretariat-Chancellery.

units.zh: 隱帝即位，就加兼侍中，改封秦國公。
units.en: When Emperor Yin ascended, Congmin was thereupon additionally made chief minister and re-enfeoffed as Duke of Qin.
units.literal: When Emperor Yin ascended, Congmin was thereupon additionally made chief minister and re-enfeoffed as Duke of Qin.

units.zh: 歲餘，以王守恩代還。
units.en: After more than a year Wang Shouen replaced him and he returned.
units.literal: After more than a year, Wang Shouen replaced him and he returned.

units.zh: 廣順元年春，以疾卒，年五十四。
units.en: In spring of the first year of Guangshun he died of illness at age fifty-four.
units.literal: In spring of the first year of Guangshun, he died of illness at age fifty-four.

units.zh: 詔贈中書令，謚曰恭惠。
units.en: An edict posthumously honored him as Director of the Secretariat. His posthumous title was Gonghui.
units.literal: An edict posthumously honored him as Director of the Secretariat; his posthumous title was Gonghui.

units.zh: 鄭仁誨，字日新，晉陽人。
units.en: Zheng Renhui, whose courtesy name was Rixin, came from Jinyang.
units.literal: Zheng Renhui, courtesy name Rixin, was a native of Jinyang.

units.zh: 父霸，累贈太子太師。
units.en: His father Ba was repeatedly posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: His father Ba was repeatedly posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 仁誨幼事唐驍將陳紹光，恃勇使酒，嘗乘醉抽佩劍，將事刂刃於仁誨，左右無不奔避，唯仁誨端立以俟，略無懼色。
units.en: In youth Renhui served the Tang fierce general Chen Shaoguang, who relied on his courage and drank heavily. Once, drunk, he drew his sword and was about to cut Renhui down. Everyone around fled, but Renhui alone stood upright and waited, showing not the slightest fear.
units.literal: In youth Renhui served the Tang fierce general Chen Shaoguang, who relied on his courage and drank heavily. Once, drunk, he drew his sword and was about to cut Renhui with the blade; everyone around fled, but only Renhui stood upright and waited, showing not the slightest fear.

units.zh: 紹光因擲劍於地，謂仁誨曰：「汝有此器度，必當享人間富貴。」
units.en: Shaoguang thereupon threw his sword to the ground and said to Renhui, "With composure like yours, you are bound to enjoy wealth and honor in this world."
units.literal: Shaoguang thereupon threw his sword to the ground and said to Renhui, "With such composure as yours, you are sure to enjoy wealth and honor among men."

units.zh: 及紹光典郡，仁誨累為右職。
units.en: When Shaoguang governed a commandery, Renhui repeatedly held senior posts.
units.literal: When Shaoguang governed a commandery, Renhui repeatedly held senior posts.

units.zh: 後退歸鄉里，以色養為樂。
units.en: Later he retired to his home district and took pleasure in supporting his parents.
units.literal: Later he retired to his home district and took pleasure in supporting his parents.

units.zh: 漢高祖之鎮河東也，太祖累就其第，與之燕語，每有質問，無不以正理為答，太祖深器之。
units.en: When the high ancestor of Han governed Hedong, Taizu repeatedly visited his home and conversed with him at ease. Whenever questioned, Renhui answered with sound principle, and Taizu came to value him deeply.
units.literal: When the high ancestor of Han governed Hedong, Taizu repeatedly visited his residence and conversed with him at ease; whenever questioned, Renhui answered always with sound principle, and Taizu greatly valued him.

units.zh: 漢有天下，太祖初領樞務，即召為從職。
units.en: When Han held the realm, as soon as Taizu first took charge of the Bureau of Military Affairs he summoned Renhui as an attendant official.
units.literal: When Han held the realm, as soon as Taizu first took charge of the Bureau of Military Affairs he summoned Renhui as an attendant official.

units.zh: 及太祖西征，嘗密贊軍機，西師凱旋，累遷至檢校吏部尚書。
units.en: When Taizu campaigned westward, Renhui secretly advised on military affairs. When the western army returned in triumph he was repeatedly promoted, eventually to honorary Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: When Taizu campaigned westward, Renhui secretly advised on military affairs; when the western army returned in triumph he was repeatedly promoted to honorary Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 太祖踐阼，旌佐命功，授檢校司空、客省使兼大內都點檢、恩州團練使，尋為樞密副使。
units.en: When Taizu took the throne he honored those who had aided his accession. Renhui was made honorary Minister of Works, commissioner of the Reception Office and overall inspector of the great inner palace, and regimental commissioner of Enzhou. Soon he was made deputy commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: When Taizu took the throne he honored those who had aided his accession and appointed Renhui honorary Minister of Works, commissioner of the Reception Office and overall inspector of the great inner palace, and regimental commissioner of Enzhou; soon he was made deputy commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 逾年轉宣徽北院使、右衛大將軍，出鎮澶淵，轉檢校太保，入為樞密使，加同平章事。
units.en: After a year he was transferred to commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Attendant Service and general of the Right Guard, sent out to govern Chanyuan, made honorary Grand Guardian, recalled as commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and made co-equal to the Secretariat-Chancellery.
units.literal: After a year he was transferred to commissioner of the Northern Court of the Palace Attendant Service and general of the Right Guard, went out to govern Chanyuan, was made honorary Grand Guardian, entered as commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and was made co-equal to the Secretariat-Chancellery.

units.zh: 世宗之北征也，以仁誨為東京留守，調發軍須，供億無所闕，駕回，加兼侍中。
units.en: When Shizong marched north, he made Renhui regent of the eastern capital. Renhui mobilized military supplies and provisions without any shortage. When the emperor returned, he was additionally made Palace Attendant.
units.literal: When Shizong campaigned north, he made Renhui regent of the eastern capital; Renhui mobilized military supplies and provisions without any shortage; when the imperial carriage returned, he was additionally made Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 尋丁內艱，未幾起復。
units.en: Soon he went into mourning for his mother. Before long he was recalled to office.
units.literal: Soon he mourned his mother; before long he was recalled to office.

units.zh: 顯德二年冬，疾亟，世宗幸其第，親加撫問，欷歔久之。
units.en: In the winter of the second year of Xiande his illness grew critical. Shizong visited his home and personally comforted him, sighing with emotion for a long while.
units.literal: In the winter of the second year of Xiande his illness grew critical; Shizong visited his residence and personally comforted and questioned him, sighing with emotion for a long while.

units.zh: 及卒，世宗親臨其喪，哭逾數舉。
units.en: When he died, Shizong personally attended his funeral and wept long and bitterly.
units.literal: When he died, Shizong personally attended his funeral and wept beyond several rounds of mourning.

units.zh: 是時，世宗將行，近臣奏云：「歲道非便，不宜臨喪。」
units.en: As Shizong was about to set out, close officials submitted, "The year's course is inauspicious. It is not fitting for Your Majesty to attend the funeral in person."
units.literal: At that time, as Shizong was about to go, close officials submitted, "The year's course is inauspicious; it is not fitting to attend the funeral in person."

units.zh: 弗聽，然而先之以桃茢之事，時以為得禮。
units.en: He paid no heed, yet he first performed the peach-branch and reed-branch rites. At the time this was considered proper ritual observance.
units.literal: He did not listen, yet he first performed the peach-branch and reed-branch rites; at the time this was considered proper ritual.

units.zh: 仁誨為人端厚謙損，造次必由於禮。
units.en: Renhui was upright, steady, humble, and self-restrained. Even in haste he always acted through ritual.
units.literal: Renhui as a man was upright, steady, humble, and self-restrained; even in haste he always acted through ritual.

units.zh: 及居樞務，雖權位崇重，而能孜孜接物，無自矜之色，至終，故朝廷鹹惜之。
units.en: When he held the Bureau of Military Affairs, although his power and rank were exalted, he still worked diligently in receiving others without a trace of self-conceit. To the end the whole court mourned him.
units.literal: When he held the Bureau of Military Affairs, although his power and rank were exalted, he could still work diligently in receiving others without a trace of self-conceit; to the end, therefore, the court all mourned him.

units.zh: 詔贈中書令，追封韓國公，謚曰忠正。
units.en: By edict he was posthumously honored as Secretariat Director, enfeoffed posthumously as Duke of Han, and given the posthumous name Zhongzheng.
units.literal: By edict he was posthumously honored as Secretariat Director, enfeoffed posthumously as Duke of Han, with the posthumous name Zhongzheng.

units.zh: 既葬，命翰林學士陶穀撰神道碑文，官為建立，表特恩也。
units.en: After the burial he ordered Hanlin academician Tao Gu to compose the spirit-way inscription and had officials erect it, a mark of special favor.
units.literal: After the burial he ordered Hanlin academician Tao Gu to compose the spirit-way inscription; officials were ordered to erect it, showing special favor.

units.zh: 子勛，累歷內職，蚤卒，絕嗣。
units.en: His son Xun repeatedly held inner-court posts, died young, and left no heir.
units.literal: His son Xun repeatedly held inner-court posts, died young, and left no heir.

units.zh: 初，廣順末，王殷受詔赴闕，太祖遣仁誨赴鄴都巡檢，及殷得罪，仁誨不奉詔即殺其子，蓋利其家財妓樂也。
units.en: Earlier, at the end of Guangshun, Wang Yin received an edict to come to court. Taizu sent Renhui to inspect Ye. When Yin fell from favor, Renhui, without awaiting an edict, immediately killed Yin's son—presumably coveting his family's wealth, singing girls, and musicians.
units.literal: Earlier, at the end of Guangshun, Wang Yin received an edict to come to court; Taizu sent Renhui to inspect Ye. When Yin fell from favor, Renhui, without awaiting an edict, immediately killed Yin's son—presumably coveting his family's wealth, singing girls, and musicians.

units.zh: 及仁誨卒而無後，人以為陰責焉。
units.en: When Renhui died without an heir, people regarded it as hidden retribution.
units.literal: When Renhui died without an heir, people regarded it as hidden retribution.

units.zh: 張彥成，潞州潞城人也。
units.en: Zhang Yancheng came from Lucheng in Luzhou.
units.literal: Zhang Yancheng was a native of Lucheng in Luzhou.

units.zh: 曾祖靜，汾州刺史。
units.en: His great-grandfather Jing was governor of Fenzhou.
units.literal: His great-grandfather Jing was governor of Fenzhou.

units.zh: 祖述，澤州刺史。
units.en: His grandfather Shu was governor of Zezhou.
units.literal: His grandfather Shu was governor of Zezhou.

units.zh: 父礪，昭義行軍司馬。
units.en: His father Li was field headquarters marshal of Zhaoyi.
units.literal: His father Li was field headquarters marshal of Zhaoyi.

units.zh: 彥成初為並門牙將。
units.en: Yancheng began his career as a guard officer in Bingzhou.
units.literal: Yancheng began as a guard officer in Bingzhou.

units.zh: 天成中，自秦州鹽鐵務官改鄆州都押牙。
units.en: During the Tiancheng era, he was transferred from a post in the Qinzhou salt and iron bureau to that of chief military adjutant of Yunzhou.
units.literal: During the Tiancheng era, he was transferred from a post in the Qinzhou salt and iron bureau to that of chief military adjutant of Yunzhou.

units.zh: 漢祖鎮北門，表為行軍司馬，以隱帝娶其女，特見親愛。
units.en: When Gaozu of Later Han held the command at Taiyuan, he recommended Yancheng as field headquarters marshal. Yancheng received particular favor because Emperor Yin had married his daughter.
units.literal: When Gaozu of Later Han held the command at Taiyuan, he recommended Yancheng as field headquarters marshal; because Emperor Yin had married Yancheng's daughter, Yancheng was especially favored.

units.zh: 從平汴、洛，累加特進、檢校太尉、同州節度使。
units.en: He followed in pacifying Bian and Luo and was repeatedly promoted to special advancement, honorary Grand Commandant, and military commissioner of Tongzhou.
units.literal: He followed in pacifying Bian and Luo and was repeatedly promoted to special advancement, honorary Grand Commandant, and military commissioner of Tongzhou.

units.zh: 隱帝即位，就加同平章事。
units.en: When Emperor Yin took the throne, Yancheng was immediately made co-equal to the Secretariat-Chancellery.
units.literal: When Emperor Yin took the throne, Yancheng was immediately made co-equal to the Secretariat-Chancellery.

units.zh: 太祖之伐河中，彥成有饋免之勞，河中平，加檢校太師。
units.en: When Taizu campaigned against Hezhong, Yancheng had the merit of supplying provisions and relief. When Hezhong was pacified he was made honorary Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: When Taizu campaigned against Hezhong, Yancheng had the merit of supplying provisions and relief; when Hezhong was pacified he was made honorary Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 乾祐三年冬，移鎮相州。
units.en: In the winter of the third year of Qianyou he was transferred to Xiangzhou.
units.literal: In the winter of the third year of Qianyou he was transferred to govern Xiangzhou.

units.zh: 廣順初，就加兼侍中，尋移鎮南陽。
units.en: Early in Guangshun he was immediately made concurrent Palace Attendant and soon transferred to Nanyang.
units.literal: At the beginning of Guangshun he was immediately made concurrent Palace Attendant and soon transferred to govern Nanyang.

units.zh: 三年秋，代歸，授右金吾衛上將軍。
units.en: In the autumn of the third year he was replaced and returned to court, and was appointed general of the Right Golden Crow Guard.
units.literal: In the autumn of the third year he was replaced and returned, and was appointed general of the Right Golden Crow Guard.

units.zh: 其年秋，以疾卒，年六十。
units.en: That autumn he died of illness, aged sixty.
units.literal: That autumn he died of illness, aged sixty.

units.zh: 贈侍中。
units.en: He was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant.
units.literal: He was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·楊克讓傳》：乾祐中，同州節度使張彥成表授掌書記。
units.en: (From the Biography of Yang Kerang in the 《History of Song》: During Qianyou, Zhang Yancheng, military commissioner of Tongzhou, recommended him as chief secretary.
units.literal: (From the Biography of Yang Kerang in the 《History of Song》: During Qianyou, Zhang Yancheng, military commissioner of Tongzhou, recommended him as chief secretary.

units.zh: 周廣順初，彥成移鎮安陽、穰下，克讓以奮職從行。
units.en: Early in Guangshun of Zhou, Yancheng was transferred to Anyang and Rangxia. Kerang followed him in diligent service.
units.literal: At the beginning of Guangshun of Zhou, Yancheng was transferred to govern Anyang and Rangxia; Kerang followed in diligent service.

units.zh: 彥成入為執金吾，病篤，奏稱其材可用。
units.en: Yancheng entered court as commander of the Golden Crow. When his illness grew critical he submitted a memorial saying Kerang's talent should be employed.
units.literal: Yancheng entered court as commander of the Golden Crow; when his illness grew critical he submitted a memorial saying Kerang's talent could be used.
