units.zh: 克讓以彥成死未葬，不忍就祿，退居別墅，俟張氏子外除，時論稱之。）〉
units.en: Kerang, because Yancheng had died and was not yet buried, could not bear to accept salary. He retired to a separate villa and waited until the Zhang family's mourning period had ended. Contemporary opinion praised him.)〉
units.literal: Kerang, because Yancheng had died and was not yet buried, could not bear to accept salary; he retired to a separate villa and waited until the Zhang family's mourning period had ended—contemporary opinion praised him.)〉

units.zh: 安叔千，沙陀三部落之種也。
units.en: An Shuqian was descended from the three Shatuo tribes.
units.literal: An Shuqian was of the stock of the three Shatuo tribes.

units.zh: 父懷盛，事唐武皇，以驍勇聞。
units.en: His father Huaisheng served Emperor Wu of Tang and was known for fierce courage.
units.literal: His father Huaisheng served Emperor Wu of Tang and was known for fierce courage.

units.zh: 叔千習騎射，從莊宗定河南為奉安部將。
units.en: Shuqian trained in horsemanship and archery. He followed Zhuangzong in settling Henan and was made a colonel of the Feng'an division.
units.literal: Shuqian practiced horsemanship and archery; he followed Zhuangzong in settling Henan and was made a colonel of the Feng'an division.

units.zh: 天成初，王師伐定州，命為先鋒都指揮使。
units.en: Early in Tiancheng, when the imperial army marched against Dingzhou, he was appointed vanguard commander.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tiancheng, when the imperial army campaigned against Dingzhou, he was appointed vanguard commander.

units.zh: 王都平，授秦州刺史，連判涿、易二郡。
units.en: After Wang Du was crushed, he was appointed governor of Qinzhou and concurrently judged Zhuo and Yi commanderies.
units.literal: When Wang Du was pacified, he was appointed governor of Qinzhou and concurrently judged Zhuo and Yi commanderies.

units.zh: 清泰初，契丹寇雁門，叔千從晉祖迎戰，敗之，進位檢校太保、振武節度使。
units.en: Early in Qingtai the Khitan raided Yanmen. Shuqian followed the founding emperor of Jin to meet them in battle, defeated them, and was advanced to honorary Grand Guardian and military commissioner of Zhenwu.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingtai the Khitan raided Yanmen; Shuqian followed the founding emperor of Jin to meet them in battle, defeated them, and was advanced to honorary Grand Guardian and military commissioner of Zhenwu.

units.zh: 晉祖踐阼，就加同平章事。
units.en: When the founding emperor of Jin took the throne, he was immediately made co-equal to the Secretariat-Chancellery.
units.literal: When the founding emperor of Jin took the throne, he was immediately made co-equal to the Secretariat-Chancellery.

units.zh: 天福中，歷邠、滄、邢、晉四鎮節度使。
units.en: During Tianfu he served successively as military commissioner of Bin, Cang, Xing, and Jin.
units.literal: During Tianfu he served successively as military commissioner of the four commands Bin, Cang, Xing, and Jin.

units.zh: 叔千鄙野而無文，當時謂之「安沒字」，言若碑碣之無篆籀，但虛有其表耳。
units.en: Shuqian was coarse and uncultured. At the time they called him "An Without Characters," meaning like a stele without seal script—only an empty surface.
units.literal: Shuqian was coarse and uncultured; at the time they called him "An Without Characters," meaning like a stele without seal script—only an empty surface.

units.zh: 開運初，朝廷將大舉北伐，授行營都排陣使，俄改左金吾衛上將軍。
units.en: Early in Kaiyun the court planned a major northern campaign. He was appointed overall battle-array commander of the field headquarters and soon was made general of the Left Golden Crow Guard.
units.literal: At the beginning of Kaiyun the court planned a major northern campaign; he was appointed overall battle-array commander of the field headquarters and soon was made general of the Left Golden Crow Guard.

units.zh: 契丹入汴，百僚迎見於赤崗，契丹主登高岡駐馬而撫諭漢官，叔千出班國語，契丹主曰：「爾是安沒字否？
units.en: When the Khitan entered Bian, the hundred officials welcomed them at Chigang. The Khitan ruler mounted a high hill, halted his horse, and comforted the Han officials. Shuqian stepped forward and spoke in the national language. The Khitan ruler said, "Are you not An Without Characters?
units.literal: When the Khitan entered Bian, the hundred officials welcomed them at Chigang. The Khitan ruler mounted a high hill, halted his horse, and comforted and instructed the Han officials. Shuqian stepped forward and spoke in the national language. The Khitan ruler said, "Are you not An Without Characters?

units.zh: 卿比在邢州日，遠輸誠款，我至此，汝管取一吃飯處。」
units.en: When you were at Xingzhou you sent sincere pledges from afar. Now that I have come here, you are sure to get a place at my table."
units.literal: When you were at Xingzhou you sent sincere pledges from afar. Now that I have come here, you are sure to get a place to eat."

units.zh: 叔千拜謝而退，俄授鎮國軍節度使。
units.en: Shuqian bowed in thanks and withdrew. Soon he was appointed military commissioner of the Zhenguo Army.
units.literal: Shuqian bowed in thanks and withdrew; soon he was appointed military commissioner of the Zhenguo Army.

units.zh: 漢初，遇代歸京，自以嘗附幕庭，居常愧惕，久之，授太子太師致仕，尋請告歸洛。
units.en: Early in the Han dynasty, when a replacement returned to the capital, he reflected that he had once attached himself to the Khitan court and lived in constant shame and fear. After a long while he was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired, and soon requested leave to return to Luoyang.
units.literal: At the beginning of Han, when a replacement returned to the capital, he reflected that he had once attached himself to the Khitan court and lived in constant shame and fear; after a long while he was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired, and soon requested leave to return to Luoyang.

units.zh: 廣順二年冬卒，年七十二。
units.en: He died in the winter of the second year of Guangshun, aged seventy-two.
units.literal: He died in the winter of the second year of Guangshun, aged seventy-two.

units.zh: 詔贈侍中。
units.en: By edict he was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant.
units.literal: By edict he was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 宋彥筠，雍丘人也。
units.en: Song Yanyun came from Yongqiu.
units.literal: Song Yanyun was a native of Yongqiu.

units.zh: 初隸滑州軍，梁氏與莊宗夾河之戰，彥筠時為戰棹都指揮使，以勞遷開封府牙校。
units.en: At first he served in the Huazhou army. In the battle between the Liang and Zhuangzong along the river, Yanyun commanded the war boats and was transferred for his merit to guard officer of the Kaifeng prefecture.
units.literal: At first he belonged to the Huazhou army; in the battle between the Liang and Zhuangzong along the river, Yanyun was then commander of the war boats and was transferred for his merit to guard officer of the Kaifeng prefecture.

units.zh: 莊宗有天下，擢領禁軍。
units.en: When Zhuangzong held the realm, he was promoted to command the palace guard.
units.literal: When Zhuangzong held the realm, he was promoted to command the forbidden troops.

units.zh: 伐蜀之役，率所部從康延孝為前鋒，蜀平，歷維、渝二州刺史。
units.en: In the campaign against Shu he led his troops under Kang Yanxiao as vanguard. When Shu was pacified he served successively as governor of Wei and Yu.
units.literal: In the campaign against Shu he led his troops following Kang Yanxiao as vanguard; when Shu was pacified he served successively as governor of Wei and Yu.

units.zh: 明宗在位，連典數郡。
units.en: While Mingzong reigned he governed several commanderies in succession.
units.literal: While Mingzong reigned he governed several commanderies in succession.

units.zh: 晉初，自汝州防禦使討安從進於襄陽，以功拜鄧州節度使，累官至檢校太尉。
units.en: Early in Jin, as defense commissioner of Ruzhou he campaigned against An Congjin at Xiangyang. For his merit he was appointed military commissioner of Dengzhou and rose to honorary Grand Commandant.
units.literal: At the beginning of Jin, as defense commissioner of Ruzhou he campaigned against An Congjin at Xiangyang; for his merit he was appointed military commissioner of Dengzhou and rose in office to honorary Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 未幾，歷晉、陜二鎮。
units.en: Before long he governed Jin and Shan in succession.
units.literal: Before long he governed the two commands Jin and Shan in succession.

units.zh: 晉少帝嗣位，再領鄧州，尋移鎮河中。
units.en: When the young emperor of Jin succeeded, he again took Dengzhou and soon was transferred to Hezhong.
units.literal: When the young emperor of Jin succeeded, he again led Dengzhou and soon was transferred to govern Hezhong.

units.zh: 漢初，授太子太師致仕。
units.en: Early in the Han dynasty he was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired.
units.literal: At the beginning of Han he was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired.

units.zh: 國初，拜左衛上將軍。
units.en: At the founding of the dynasty he was appointed general of the Left Guard.
units.literal: At the founding of the dynasty he was appointed general of the Left Guard.

units.zh: 世宗嗣位，復為太子太師致仕。
units.en: When Shizong succeeded he again became Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired.
units.literal: When Shizong succeeded he again became Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired.

units.zh: 顯德四年冬，卒於西京之私第。
units.en: In the winter of the fourth year of Xiande he died at his private residence in the western capital.
units.literal: In the winter of the fourth year of Xiande he died at his private residence in the western capital.

units.zh: 輟視朝一日，詔贈侍中。
units.en: Court was suspended for one day. By edict he was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant.
units.literal: Court audiences were suspended for one day; by edict he was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 初，彥筠入成都，據一甲第，第中資貨鉅萬，妓女數十輩，盡為其所有。
units.en: When Yanyun first entered Chengdu he seized a grand mansion stocked with wealth in the tens of thousands and several dozen singing girls, all of which became his.
units.literal: When Yanyun first entered Chengdu he seized a grand mansion; within it were wealth of tens of thousands and several dozen singing girls, all of which became his.

units.zh: 一旦，與其主母微忿，遽擊殺之，自後常有所睹，彥筠心不自安，乃修浮屠法以禳之，因而溺誌於釋氏。
units.en: Once, after a slight quarrel with the mistress of the house, he suddenly struck and killed her. Thereafter he often had visions. Yanyun's heart was uneasy, so he practiced Buddhist rites to exorcise them and became obsessed with the Buddha's teaching.
units.literal: Once, after a slight quarrel with the mistress of the house, he suddenly struck and killed her. Thereafter he often had visions; Yanyun's heart was uneasy, so he practiced Buddhist rites to exorcise them and thus became obsessed with the Buddha's teaching.

units.zh: 其後，每歲至金仙入涅之日，常衣斬缞號慟於其像前，其佞佛也如是。
units.en: Thereafter, every year on the day when the Golden Immortal entered nirvana, he would wear hemmed sackcloth and wail before the image. Such was his devotion to Buddhism.
units.literal: Thereafter, every year on the day when the Golden Immortal entered nirvana, he would wear hemmed sackcloth and wail before the image—such was his devotion to Buddhism.

units.zh: 家有侍婢數十人，皆令削髮披緇，以侍左右，大為當時所誚。
units.en: He had several dozen maidservants at home, all of whom he had shave their heads and don black robes to attend him—a practice greatly mocked by his contemporaries.
units.literal: He had several dozen maidservants at home, all of whom he had shave their heads and don black robes to attend him—greatly mocked by his contemporaries.

units.zh: 又性好貨殖，能圖什一之利，良田甲第，相望於郡國。
units.en: He also loved trade and could turn a ten-percent profit. Fine fields and grand mansions stretched across the commanderies.
units.literal: He also loved trade and could seek a ten-percent profit; fine fields and grand mansions stretched across the commanderies.

units.zh: 將終，以伊、洛之間田莊十數區上進，並籍於官焉。
units.en: As he neared death he presented more than ten estates between the Yi and Luo rivers to the throne, and all were registered to the state.
units.literal: As he neared death he presented more than ten estates between the Yi and Luo rivers to the throne, and all were registered to the state.

units.zh: 史臣曰：近代領戎藩，列王爵，祿厚而君子不議，望重而人主不疑，能自晦於飲酌之間，保功名於始終之際，如行周之比者，幾何人哉！
units.en: The historian says: In recent times, how many men commanded a military frontier, held a princely rank, enjoyed thick salary without gentlemen's censure, carried heavy prestige without the ruler's suspicion, concealed themselves amid drinking, and preserved fame and merit from beginning to end—men like Xingzhou!
units.literal: The historian says: In recent times to command a military frontier, hold a princely rank, enjoy thick salary without gentlemen's censure, carry heavy prestige without the ruler's suspicion, be able to conceal oneself amid drinking, and preserve fame and merit from beginning to end—how many men were there like Xingzhou!

units.zh: 奕世藩翰，固亦宜然。
units.en: Generations of frontier pillars—this was only fitting.
units.literal: Generations of frontier pillars—this was only fitting.

units.zh: 審琦有分閫之勞，乏禦家之道，峰摧玉折，蓋不幸也。
units.en: Shenqi had the merit of sharing command of the frontier but lacked the way of governing his household. Peak shattered, jade broken—this was surely misfortune.
units.literal: Shenqi had the merit of sharing command of the frontier but lacked the way of governing his household; peak shattered, jade broken—this was surely misfortune.

units.zh: 其餘雖擁戎旃，未聞閫政，固不足與文、召、龔、黃為比也。
units.en: The rest, although they bore military banners, were not known for frontier governance and surely cannot be compared with Wen, Zhao, Gong, and Huang.
units.literal: The rest, although they bore military banners, were not known for frontier governance and surely cannot be compared with Wen, Zhao, Gong, and Huang.
